questions.question: Which one of the following memories is extremely fast and acts as a high-speed buffer between the CPU and the main memory?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Cache Memory . Key Points The memory that is extremely fast and acts as a high-speed buffer between the CPU and the main memory is called Cache Memory . Cache memory is a small, high-speed memory that stores frequently accessed data and instructions to reduce the average time to access data from the main memory. The CPU can access the cache memory much faster than the main memory, as it is located on the same chip as the CPU or very close to it.  Additi

questions.question:
Which one of the following statements is correct?

A device driver of output devices
options: interprets input provided by users into computer usable form.
interprets computer output into user understandable form.
translates user inputs into output device.
facilitates user to communicate with output device.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  interprets computer output into user understandable form . Key Points A device driver is a specialized software that allows the operating system and applications to communicate with hardware devices. questions.question: Which one of the following is not an audio file format?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is SWF . Key Points SWF stands for Shockwave Flash , which is a file format used for multimedia content, particularly animation and interactive media, on the internet. This file format was created by macromedia and now is owned by Adobe. Additional Information Audio file format refers to the structure or organization of digital audio data stored in a file. Some of the commonly used audio file formats include: MP3 (MPEG Audio Layer-3) WAV (Waveform Audio File Format)
